explicit_requirements: Return one preview label for a supplied recipient and postal code.
Trim the recipient, trim and uppercase the postal code, and set service to standard.
Reject blank recipient or postal code.
inferred_behaviors: Absent or non-text recipient and postal-code values should be rejected rather than treated as valid label text; the supplied context exposes text processing and validates both values.

scenarios.name: Produce one normalized label
scenarios.behavior: Return one label whose recipient has surrounding whitespace removed, whose postal code has surrounding whitespace removed and is uppercase, and whose service is standard.
scenarios.reason: These related properties and the single-label output are directly specified by the task.

scenarios.name: Reject blank label fields
scenarios.behavior: Reject a blank recipient or postal code, including whitespace-only text.
scenarios.reason: The task requires blank-field rejection and describes trimming the supplied values.

scenarios.name: Preview without purchasing postage
scenarios.behavior: Generating a preview does not purchase postage.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly separates previewing from purchasing postage.

scenarios.name: Reject absent or non-text label fields
scenarios.behavior: Reject absent or non-text recipient and postal-code values instead of producing a label from them.
scenarios.reason: The supplied context processes text and checks both fields for string values; input validation is directly relevant to preview generation.
